description: Branch R-FMT-2 II-05 Statistics word (public DistinctCount rule) on a ACCDB. D(ID Long primary key, K Long, S Text(10)) with non-unique IX_K on K and unique UX_S on S. After each of these steps, one at a time, every index's DistinctCount, Primary, Unique and fields are read (TableDefs and Indexes refreshed): insert (1,10,'a'); insert (2,20,'b'); insert a duplicate key (3,10,'c'); delete that duplicate; delete the last row with K = 10; reinsert K = 10; update K 20 to 30 and back to 20; an insert refused for a duplicate S; an insert with a duplicate K; AddNew then CancelUpdate; an UPDATE refused for a duplicate S. Then the file is closed and the indexes read after a read-only reopen, and again from a DBEngine.CompactDatabase copy. Asks the increment, decrement and refusal rule of the statistic, and whether reopen and compaction change it.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
